cohort: 851 singleton infants born between 2010 and 2015 in a peri-urban region of Telangana State, India
finding: Cesarean delivery was not associated with an increased risk of maternal-reported infant diarrhea, respiratory symptoms, or comorbid diarrhea and respiratory infection at 6 months of age.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was not associated with an increased risk of short-term adverse gastrointestinal or respiratory infant outcomes at 6 months of age compared to vaginal delivery.
